name: Slide With You
storyline: Slide With You is a story-based game that tells the tale of a woman's life, with each level representing a different stage of her life. It details how she fell in love, the pain of losing her loved one, and her final days as she succumbs to dementia. The final stage has her journeying to heaven to join her loved one as a star in the sky.
summary: The slide of life takes you in many directions. Some joyful, some not so much. But in the end all slides lead to the same destination. On your final night your hear that melody one last time. The same melody you have heard all of your life. One last time down memory lane.
